label: Every actual CONCRETE_6 member of the full selected ancestry cone…, by Proof by cases and reductio
rule: Proof by cases (excluded middle) and reductio
meaning: If the selected cone has no contingent root ancestor (OPEN), then every contingent cone member has an actual concrete ground: by excluded middle it has one or has none, and if none it would be a contingent root ancestor. The cone-local analogue of everyContingentGrounded_iff_noContingentRoot; a relocation to the denial of a brute contingent foundation in the cone, not a defence of it.
